interpretation.ranking: Descending largest cross-venue observed price difference before costs. Does not imply profit, probability, or executable arbitrage.
interpretation.identity: Only provided structured Cup state/race/office/General stage/2026 election date/party versus verified external generic-party record. House district parsed only from explicit structured raceName, never opaque IDs or Cup title.
limitations: All predicates and special-election equivalence need independent review
Cup quotes and identities are historical; neither venue source quote age is known
Receipt clocks are retained separately; observations are not synchronized
Distinct external contracts remain distinct; no duplicate collapse or party complement assumption
Price differences exclude fees, quantity/depth, cross-venue execution, settlement timing and correlated risk
No record is suitable for a paper probability cohort until source-backed estimates and exact reviewed predicates are supplied
